references.text: The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson in Dan's camp between Zorah and Eshtaol, the same towns from which the Danites set out.
Earlier in the same chapter, Zorah and Eshtaol are mentioned as the starting point for the spies from Dan.
The six hundred armed men of Dan are mentioned again when they stand at the gate while the spies enter the house.
The tribe of Dan did not take possession of its allotted territory and therefore had to go out to conquer new land.
At the census in the wilderness of Sinai, the tribe of Dan was counted, and this verse refers to that same tribe as it now sets out.
Dan's camp broke up as the rear guard for all the camps, showing the tribe's military organization.
